basis.interpretation: 40 tactical pregens for each of 8 combat-role categories = 320 kits
basis.source_policy: Setting names/chassis/origins are grounded in the supplied corebook. Exact attacks, reactions and combat loops are new design extensions for the encounter generator.

design_rules: A pregen is a tactical kit, not a fixed numeric statblock.
Numeric Body/Armor/PZ/pool/Expl/damage/Pen are applied by the existing scaler after kit selection.
primary is always the sustained role-defining action and must be the attack used for encounter-profile normalization unless an explicit primaryAttackId overrides it.
reaction hard requirements must be satisfied by the selected kit.
secondary must solve a weakness, create setup, or cover a different range/function than primary.
special is limited-use and should not replace the sustained primary action.
boss/chief/minion scale changes numbers and optional additions, not the tactical identity.
